name: Robotic Welding Heat Input
description: Heat input per unit length during robotic arc welding. Checks whether material properties are preserved.

elements.name: Heat Input per Unit Length
elements.description: Thermal energy input during weld pass. Uncertain due to arc voltage and wire feed speed variation.

uncertainty.source: Weld parameter monitoring data from 200 test welds

elements.name: Maximum Heat Input per Specification
elements.description: Welding procedure specification maximum for S355 structural steel

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(U, I) = (U · I) / (v · 1000); F scales voltage and current uncertainty into heat input domain
consistency_relations.upr_description: Heat input per unit length is an affine function of arc voltage and current: Q = (U·I)/(v·1000) kJ/mm. This parametric mapping propagates the joint uncertainty in voltage and current through the welding physics formula into the heat input domain, where it is compared against the WPS maximum.
